digest.component_or_area: Architecture Decision Record (ADR) registry and indexing
propositions: ADR corpus has 91 files but only 69 distinct numbers; 17 numbers are duplicated across 22 files, causing ambiguity and collision risk.
Per-number marker files (docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN) with filename content enable git's add/add conflict detection to prevent concurrent same-number assignments race-free.
22 duplicate-numbered ADRs are renumbered to 0070-0091 (ascending landing-date order, earliest-landed keeps original number) and cross-references rewritten to resolve ambiguity.
CI gate (scripts/check_adr_numbers.py) enforces bijection between ADRs and markers, unique marker content, and referential integrity of adr/NNNN-slug links in docs/ and intra-ADR cross-links.
Generated docs/adr/README.md index and docs/adr/RENUMBERING.md (with per-reference resolution tiers) document the final state and disambiguation for the 4 unresolvable references.
